free_tier_limits.correction: Trial access: 1,000 requests/day per app (universal) plus per-category daily caps (e.g. org_write/ads_write 300/day). Standard access: 100 requests/second per user per app (universal) plus published per-category per-minute limits. No paid API usage tiers; free Trial/Standard with rate limits.

rate_limits.correction: Published. Universal: Trial 1000 req/day all requests; Standard 100 req/sec per user per app. Plus per-category limits (e.g. org_read Standard 1000/min, org_write 100/min, ads_analytics 300/min, ads_write 400/min, org_analytics 60/min). See official rate-limits table.
